source_context_translations.translation: The Way that can be spoken of is not the constant Way; the name that can be named is not the constant name.
Nameless, it is the beginning of Heaven and Earth; named, it is the mother of the ten thousand things.
Therefore, one is ever without desire, so as to observe its subtlety,
and ever with desire, so as to observe its boundaries;

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): a physical way for travel or movement
Sentence Translations (English): The broad road runs through the open country.
Ahead is a road that carts can take.
He was lost and had lost the path.
They followed the road and advanced.

additional_senses.Dictionary Meaning (English): to utter words or express something in speech
additional_senses.Nuance (English): Used for verbal expression, especially formal statement.
Sentence Translations (English): The Master spoke of the matter.
I do not dare to say it.
Each person tells what he has heard.
The historian records it as it was said.

contextual_sense.Dictionary Meaning (English): the underlying cosmic way or principle by which things arise, operate, and are explained
contextual_sense.Nuance (English): In this opening line it is a metaphysical term, not an ordinary road or method.
contextual_sense.Register (English): Laozi base text; received Wang Bi recension
